results.Keywords: stock, trading, ohlc, candlestick, finance, price, volume, accessible chart, keyboard accessible chart
results.When to Use: Financial time-series with Open/High/Low/Close data; trading or investment product context only
results.When NOT to Use: Non-financial audience; no OHLC data available (use line chart); accessibility-first context
results.Data Volume Threshold: Real-time: Canvas required. Historical: paginate by time range. Max 500 candles visible at once
results.Color Guidance: Bullish: #26A69A. Bearish: #EF5350. Volume bars: 40% opacity below. Body fill vs hollow for OHLC style
results.Accessibility Notes: Use filled versus hollow candles and OHLC text values; bullish/bearish meaning cannot depend on color. Do not rely on color alone.
results.A11y Fallback: Sortable OHLC table plus daily-change summary. Keyboard: focus reveals candle values; +/- buttons zoom; Reset restores range; live updates do not steal focus.

results.Keywords: trend, time-series, line, growth, timeline, progress, accessible chart, keyboard accessible chart
results.When to Use: Data has a time axis; user needs to observe rise/fall trends or rate of change over a continuous period
results.When NOT to Use: Fewer than 4 data points (use stat card); more than 6 series (visual noise); no time dimension exists
results.Data Volume Threshold: <1000 pts: SVG; ≥1000 pts: Canvas + downsampling; >10000: aggregate to intervals
results.Color Guidance: Primary: #0080FF. Multiple series: distinct colors + distinct line styles. Fill: 20% opacity
results.Accessibility Notes: Use solid, dashed, and dotted line styles plus direct series labels; never distinguish series by hue alone.
results.A11y Fallback: Visible data table plus concise trend summary. Keyboard: focus reveals hover values; +/- buttons zoom; Reset restores the full range.

results.Keywords: radar, spider, multi-variable, attributes, dimensions, comparison, accessible chart, keyboard accessible chart
results.When to Use: Comparing multiple entities across the same fixed set of attributes (e.g., product feature comparison)
results.When NOT to Use: Axes > 8 (unreadable); values need precise comparison (use grouped bar); audience unfamiliar with radar charts
results.Data Volume Threshold: 2–3 datasets maximum per chart; 5–8 axes; beyond 8 axes switch to parallel coordinates
results.Color Guidance: Single dataset: #0080FF at 20% fill. Multiple: distinct hues with 30% fill. Border: full opacity
results.Accessibility Notes: Use line styles, point shapes, and direct series labels in addition to color. Do not rely on color alone.
results.A11y Fallback: Raw data table and grouped-bar alternative plus comparison summary. Keyboard: focus reveals values; buttons toggle series.
